ctx.x: Teddy Edwards was in your band; Yusef Lateef who was known as Bill Evans.
Yeah, and Bill Evans not only, but Bill Evans was responsible really

for a very fine trumpet player, Julius Watkins; a trumpet and french horn. I always liked to be different, when a young man was wanting to join or I was auditioning anybody, when he had some doubles, that's when it attracted my attention, and so Bill Evans it was then, when he first started, like musicians will do, he kind of liked the group so he said if you ever need a trumpet man I have someone I would like for you to have and he recommended Julius Watkins and he went on to explain to me about him doubling on…
